name: Gästehaus Marco
beschreibung: Gästehaus Marco is located in Tyrol, Austria, operating as a traditional alpine inn. The atmosphere throughout the house is authentic, grounded, and rustic. Guests can expect straightforward accommodations complemented by an inviting on-site restaurant. The rustic dining room serves hearty regional specialties in a cozy, unpretentious setting. The guest rooms are functionally furnished, catering perfectly to outdoor and sports enthusiasts. The dramatic mountain world of the Tyrolean Alps encourages invigorating hikes and excursions. Amenities include a scenic outdoor guest garden and complimentary private parking.
